MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.




About the Role



Oracle Fusion Application Analyst




Key support role - Oracle Fusion Cloud (ERP-SCM) environment


Provide functional and technical support for Monash Health's critical enterprise application.


Permanent, full time role, based at Scoresby Corporate Site




Monash Health is the largest healthcare provider in Victoria and is recognised for its exceptional clinical care and research. We are dedicated to providing outstanding patient care. We appreciate our unique and vital role as an integral part of the communities we serve and the importance of maintaining our services in a changing environment. The integrity of our corporate systems is critical to our ability to deliver excellent care to every patient, every time.



This role represents a great opportunity within our newly formed Applications and Enablement team. Reporting to the Manager Finance Systems, you'll be part of a team responsible for ensuring our systems perform reliably and consistently, delivering both business continuity and continuous improvement. Working closely with business stakeholders, vendors and in-house digital teams, you'll play an integral role in optimising Oracle Fusion to help Monash Health deliver tomorrow's care today.



If appointed, your contribution will be assessed across five Key Result Areas:




Operational Support


System Configuration and Maintenance


Stakeholder Engagement


Continuous Improvement


Governance, Risk and Compliance




This role is expected to work in a hybrid model, with a minimum of three days per week on site in our Scoresby Office.




About you


The Oracle Application Analyst ensures the effective integration of technology with all business functions to maximize organisational performance. Develops and maintains positive relationships between Business Services and its customers. With strong system knowledge and highly developed communication skills you can demonstrate the ability to translate technical problems into language that's easy to understand for non-technical stakeholders. 



Naturally curious, you readily analyse business processes and translate requirements into system solutions. Above all, you are a committed team player who enjoys working collaboratively with colleagues to provide a consistently high level of service to your stakeholders. 



On a personal level, you are:




Highly organised


Flexible and able to adapt readily to changing priorities 


A highly effective communicator, with active listening skills


Sound technical understanding of systems and related business processes




What you need



To be considered for this role, you will need to demonstrate:




Tertiary qualification in Information Technology or Business 


Strong functional knowledge of one or more Oracle Fusion modules (ERP, EPM, SCM)


Experience working within an Application Managed Services (AMS) or shared services support model


Proven ability to analyse incidents, identify root causes and coordinate resolution across a number of teams


Demonstrated experience providing Level 2 and Level 3 application support for Oracle Fusion Could, in a complex enterprise environment


Experience with incident, problem and change management in an enterprise environment




While not mandatory requirements, experience with the following will be highly regarded:




Supporting integrations, reporting and security roles within Oracle Fusion


Oracle Fusion reporting tools (OTBI and BI Publisher) 


Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and enterprise integrations




We are especially interested in hearing from you if you've worked in a large public sector or healthcare organisation. 




Benefits of working at Monash Health




Monash Health offers a range of benefits, including: 




Comprehensive employee health and wellbeing programs including Fitness Passport


Five weeks annual leave with leave loading


Monthly ADOs for full-time employees 


Salary packaging benefits



For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Sherree O'Connell, Head of Enterprise Corporate Applications and Enablement on 0451 309 776

At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 







Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 







You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do.
